name: Osaki Yukari
source:
A puppy-like girl who practically advertises “I love my big brother!” with her whole body.

Whenever she has free time, she clings tightly to her brother and showers him with affection—an extremely spoiled little sister.
Basically, she wants to do everything her brother does, and she can’t stand not being with him.
If he lets his guard down, she’ll try to follow him not just to bed, but even into the bath—an awfully bold kid in more ways than one.
Because she’s still young, her feelings come out in such a straightforward way that even her brother sometimes gets flustered…

[b]Occupation:[/b] Student
[b]Likes:[/b] Sweet and cold things, fluffy and soft things
[b]Dislikes:[/b] Green peppers, carrots, medicine, the dark
[b]Hobby:[/b] Being with her big brother

[b]"Nii-nii!"[/b]
